items.note: S1.2.1 states (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restoration for arbitrary scratch values; S1.2.1.1 gives the central coefficients |S cap T| mod 2 or (|S cap T|-1)/2 with side cancellation and S1.2.1.2 the three-stage composition, as in 741-765. The scratch-cancellation step (net change independent of a,c) appears only in the motivation, and the wire counts W_b, W_c (767-782) are not given.

S1.2.2 gives the frame common to a gate's incidences, the commuting argument and D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, all correct. It omits the edge operator D_vD_u^{-1} and the route sign epsilon_w, saying only 'endpoint frame ratio'.

Nested nondegenerate labels in F^{tensor 3}, the only decreasing edges being central returns losing h, and sum |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L with L<N/2 all match the lemma. L=Ich, the triple-indicator construction and the exact ratios 100/539 and 101/539 are missing.

The endpoint difference I_m, the rank sum s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b<W_bm and the resulting H<-H+D on every row are stated correctly. The source matrix -P_{U_a} (essential to the endpoint identity and the source of the -N) and the frames Phi_M are missing; 'projection matrices as frames' blurs the matrices M_v with the frames Phi_{M_v}.

One kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, s_c=W_cm-2N+2L_c<W_cm and C^{tensor e} on every role are all stated. The phase frame C_U = H^{tensor m} diag(i^{q_U}) H^{tensor m} and the diagonal Z/i^{27} corrections are not given.

Plan gives L<N/2, positive deficits N-2L_b and 2N-2L_c, both relative deficits above 20*2^{-50}, and s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}, as at 1331-1343. The explicit eta values and the log m<20 step are not shown.

The digit permutations and moves, splits and merges, cyclic row splits into W streams of volume V/W and controlled shifts are listed at O(V). The controlled-shift statement drops the hypotheses (prime q, offset preparable in b^{O(1)} time, units prime to q). The method sentence is generic, so this is not counted as a derivation.

Both lemmas are stated as in the paper, the factorization E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones and the shear costing exactly a interchanges plus O(V). Neither the elimination proof nor the one-interchange trick D_j<-D_j+H_i, swap, D_j<-H_i-D_j is shown.

The route follows the paper: cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, shear frames giving H<-H+D on every row, the three updates, and F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) giving O(e^tau). 'Enough rows' loosens the W^k divisibility hypothesis. The fixed-tape depth-first schedule (1559-1615) that justifies the O(1) node term is missing, as is the geometric-sum argument.

S1.3 states O(Vu^tau) for disjoint u-bit chunks. Its method and S1.3.4 follow the paper's reduction: high digits as rows, padding rows, a base-m split of the width into power-width pieces, and padding binary chunks to radix q. Unequal widths are not treated.

s child calls on e/m axes giving C^{tensor e} on every role, and H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D, are stated correctly. Missing are the conjugation by P_M that puts residual directions on coordinate slots and the inverse-child identity (C^{-1})^{tensor f}=(-i)^f Z C Z; binary basis changes appear only in S1.4's method.

Eight cyclic shifts, guard values, sort-based repair and O(V(L^tau+1)) all match. The selected positions rho+iK, the restored third chunk, delta_bad and the full bound with its parameter-family conditions are omitted.

The recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) unrolling to O(d^{lambda'}) is correct. The leaf case F(e)=O(e) for e<d^beta, the conditions s/W<=m^sigma and K<=e^{c/beta}, the lambda' range and the base-m pieces are missing.

Statement (H_0 on one selected bit per chunk, O(Vd^{lambda'}), error below sqrt2 2^{-p}) matches. The sub-steps follow the proof at 2686-2758: phase-frame children, packed basis changes, the recurrence, the H_0 identity and guard width Delta=o(p). The guard-width recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E is only asserted.

Bit-reversed B_tF_t^-, the reversed procedure F_t^+B_t^{-1}, layout at common chunk offsets, error sqrt2 l 2^{-p} and the cost all match the lemmas. Character cancellation F^+F^-=t^{-1}I and the exact counterparts LBF^- are not stated.
Q_p(fg/r) is computed exactly by signed Kronecker packing with four products by the O(N log N) multiplier, in O(rp log(rp)), as in the lemma; B_0=2^{4p} is not given.

Error and cost match the proposition. The method (two forward transforms, pointwise products in the retained stored order, opposite transform) and the error sum M(3delta+eta) follow the paper; the final exact scale by M is only implicit in S2.4.

P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA, the tensor form, the linewise error dp^2 and the costs are correct. 'Enough separation' replaces theta>p/alpha^4, and the definitions of P_s, P_t and the one-dimensional error p^2 are missing. Only the tensoring step is shown.
Both identities are stated exactly, the chirp form of QF_t and the cancellation (RF_s^+)[(RF_s u)(RF_s v)]=(u*v)/S^2. The conjugation remark for RF_s^+ is omitted.
The prime interval, T/2<S<T and alpha^4 theta_i>p (S6), and tau, lambda', c, epsilon (S11) are correct. Missing are b, p=6b, d, K, T, the t_i choice, eta=1/(4d), delta, lambda and Tp=Theta(n).
Map, isomorphism, triangular controlled shifts and cost match, but mu_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i and the triangular digit formula are not given.
Twist by zeta^k with zeta=e^{pi i/r} and M_C(f,g)=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T are stated as in the paper.

The algorithm is outlined only in S0's method and alluded to in S10. The source-transform composition 2^gamma B_0 C A = RF_s, the conjugate procedure F^+, the scales by S and 2^{2b+4}S and the six steps are not given.
Final error below 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2, so rounding and carries give the exact product, matches eq:final-error. The chain E_s, E_w and the use of gamma<=b/4 are not shown.

Every normalized row is at most p^{1-2kappa} with min margin 2^{-181}=2kappa, giving O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}), as in the paper. The table rows, Tp=Theta(n) and the absorption of log p powers are not listed.
Named only through S0's relies-on (nlogn-conjecture) and its motivation; the liminf negation argument is absent.

errors.says: Gather and scatter through the h central wires give coefficient |S cap T| mod 2 (or (|S cap T|-1)/2).
errors.paper: The complex construction has a further central wire C_ast (c_c=101 per invocation), and its scatter adds (sum_{i in S} C_i - C_ast)/2; only the bit construction uses exactly h central wires.

errors.says: With projection matrices as frames, the bit network has endpoint matrix difference I_m on every role.
errors.paper: The projections P_U are the matrices M_v; the frames are the address shears Phi_{M_v}. The endpoint identity also needs the source matrix -P_{U_a} at X_a, which the step omits.

errors.says: Each route applies the endpoint frame ratio.
errors.paper: The route applies epsilon_w D_{sink(rho(w))} D_{source(w)}^{-1}, including the scalar sign of the signed role permutation.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound. Networks with a rank deficit (S1.2) feed chunk interchange (S1.3) and the simultaneous layer (S1.4), which feed the synthetic transforms and convolution (S2), resampling and the chirp (S3-S5, S9), CRT and digits (S7-S8), exact recovery (S10) and the margin count (S11). It thins out in two places: the multiplication algorithm's assembly (source transform, the scales by S, F^+ by conjugation) is only implicit, and S1.2 states the label budget and rank sums without the projection-rank argument or the -P_{U_a} source matrix that produce s_b.

steps.note: The bank exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch wire restored, built from triple-subset invocations, is stated. The defining parameters are never given: h=100, banks indexed by triples in T^3, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3. Conservative verdict.

S1.2's motivation and S1.2.2 state that a common invertible frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate. They also give that the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and that only edge frame changes cost.

S1.2.3 gives nested nondegenerate labels in F^{tensor 3} and comparable labels on every edge; the only decreasing edges are the central-wire returns, each losing h. 'Returns' is the paper's word for the time-3-to-4 edge (955-957); dim F^{tensor 3}=m is not stated.
The plan never says that P_V-P_U has rank dim V - dim U. Nor does it say that the N source edges are rank-one exceptions; the -N versus -2N in s_b is left unexplained.
Sum |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L and s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b are both stated; L=Ich is not written out, though the loss h per central wire is.
L<N/2, the deficit N-2L_b>0 (and 2N-2L_c>0) and s<Wm are stated. The exact ratios 100/539 and 101/539 are not.
The endpoint difference is I_m on every role, so the network applies H<-H+D on every original row, scratch rows included. The -P_{U_a} source matrix that makes it hold is missing.
The factorization E_1 Pi E_2 gives exactly a interchanges plus O(V) per rank-a shear. S1.3's method and motivation make each edge cost its rank in smaller interchanges, s in all.
Children have volume V/W and F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) gives O(e^tau). Deficits above 20*2^{-50} give s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}; the log m<20 step is not written.

central.summary: P08 reconstructs most of the chain from network to exponent: frames, labels, the budget Wm-2N+2L, L<N/2, the endpoint identity, rank-many recursive interchanges and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. It is thin at the two ends. The fixed network's parameters (h=100, N, m) are never given, and the link from label dimension to edge rank (P_V-P_U, the rank-one source exceptions) is never stated.
